bullets.title: MSFT: Azure +43% drives massive beat; PTs raised to $525-$600, Copilot at 30M seats
bullets.body: Microsoft F4Q26 revenue of $90B (+18% YoY) beat consensus by ~3%, with Azure growing 43% YoY (vs. 39-41% expected) and guided to 45% in F1Q27. Copilot paid seats surpassed 30M (from 20M last quarter) with revenue accelerating 60%+ QoQ. Multiple banks raised PTs: JPM to $550, Citi to $600, UBS to $525, Wolfe to $550, Mizuho to $510; capex guidance maintained ~$175B CY26 (accounting reclassification from 15- to 25-year useful life). Stock up 8-10% AH.

bullets.title: META: Earnings miss/AI capex surge send stock -10%; sell-side cuts PTs but most maintain Buy
bullets.body: META Q2 revenue $60.8B (+28% YoY, beat) but EPS $6.18 missed $7.19 consensus on $2.4B legal charge and $1.18B severance; GAAP operating margin 30.9% vs. 35.6% expected. FY26 capex guided to $130-145B (raised low-end from $125B) with FCF collapsing 91% YoY to $784M. Q3 revenue guide of $61-64B slightly below $63.1B consensus. MS upgraded to OW ($775 PT); JPM kept Neutral and cut PT to $640; Citi cut to $800 (Buy); Piper cut to $785; Scotiabank cut to $600. Consensus still 90% Buy at avg $794 PT.

bullets.title: EQIX: Strong 2Q, guidance raised, massive capex ramp; MS/JPM/UBS all raise PTs to $1,250-$1,300
bullets.body: Equinix 2Q26 adj. EBITDA $1.40B beat by ~3%; bookings +23% YoY to $424M with 9.7k net interconnections. Management raised 2027-2029 revenue growth guidance to 10-13% and capex to $5-7B annually (vs. $3-4B prior), targeting 53%+ EBITDA margins by 2029. MS reiterated Top Pick OW at $1,250; JPM raised PT to $1,300 (Dec-27); UBS raised PT to $1,265. Stock up ~3% AH.

bullets.title: ARM: Beat Q1/Q2 guide but royalty growth guidance cut to high-teens; PT cuts from UBS/MS
bullets.body: ARM reported Q1 revenue $1.29B (beat $1.26B est.) and EPS $0.45 (beat $0.40). Guided Q2 revenue $1.38B midpoint and EPS 43-51c. Data-center royalties doubled YoY but smartphone weakness broadened from low-end to mid/premium-tier, cutting FY27 royalty growth guidance to high-teens from ~20%. UBS cut PT to $320 from $360 (Buy maintained); MS raised PT to $212 from $202 (EW maintained). AGI CPU demand exceeds $2B but supply-constrained. Stock -5% to -8% AH.

bullets.title: CVNA: 2Q EBITDA miss + conservative 3H guide; stock -8% but JPM/Citi maintain Buy
bullets.body: Carvana Q2 retail units +38% YoY to 197K but adj. EBITDA missed estimates on 150bp GoS margin compression; 3Q guidance came in below Street. JPM reiterated OW with Dec-27 PT of $100; Citi reiterated Buy; BTIG/Jefferies cut PTs to $87/$88, JPM raised to $100, RBC cut to $82. JPM models $3.0B FY26 EBITDA and expects 4Q26 EBITDA/unit return to growth as a re-rating catalyst.

bullets.title: HOOD: Big Q2 beat on prediction markets, Trump accounts; Mizuho raises PT to $130
bullets.body: Robinhood Q2 EPS $0.62 (vs. $0.41E) and revenue $1.31B (vs. $1.21BE); prediction market revenue ($156M) exceeded equities ($129M) and crypto ($100M). Gold subscribers reached 4.8M (+17% YoY), Trump Accounts had 7M+ signups with $1.5B deposited, and 13 business lines now exceed $100M ARR. Mizuho maintains Outperform, raises PT to $130 on Trump Accounts funnel. MS rates EW at $124 PT, flagging July NNA slowdown.

bullets.title: BE: Mizuho upgrades to Outperform ($242 PT) on Q2 beat and margin expansion
bullets.body: Bloom Energy Q2 revenue exceeded $1B for first time driven by AI data center demand; operating leverage materializing earlier than anticipated. Mizuho upgraded from Neutral to Outperform with PT cut to $242 (from $285) reflecting lower service revenue and multiple compression, but supported by >$27B financing capacity and hyperscaler validation. Stock +8% pre-market.

bullets.title: VRT: Demand intact despite 2Q timing miss; UBS sees dislocation to buy
bullets.body: Vertiv 2Q results impacted by deal timing but demand signals remain intact; 3Q organic growth guided 35% and 4Q implying ~40%. Mizuho cut PT to $300 from $380 (Outperform maintained); UBS says buy the dislocation with stock at sub-18x FY28 EPS. Multiple desks note backlog mix shift toward converged/modular infrastructure.

bullets.title: AXTI/LITE: AXTI secures long-term agreements with COHR ($22.3M) and LITE ($87M) for InP substrates
bullets.body: Applied DNA Sciences secured LTA with Coherent (COHR) with $22.3M reservation payment and a separate $87M LTA ($43.5M + $43.5M) with Lumentum (LITE) for InP substrate capacity. Both COHR and LITE are leading optical players; AXTI stock +7.6% pre-market on the Lumentum long-term deal announcement.

bullets.title: NBIS/IREN/CORZ/CRWV: AI infrastructure names get partial lift; Situational Awareness hedge fund raises capital after AI rout
bullets.body: In pre-market, NBIS +9.6%, IREN +8.6%, CORZ +7.4% (KBW upgrade) while CRWV hit 52-week lows. FT confirms AI-focused Situational Awareness hedge fund (Leopold Aschenbrenner) seeking fresh capital after heavy losses; fund was up 439% YTD through June but used leverage and suffered sharp drawdown. Fund holds puts on NVDA (9M shares), AMD (4.8M), AVGO (3.3M), ORCL (7.3M).

bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang in Oval Office; SpaceX planning 4GW compute buildout using Rubin racks
bullets.body: Jensen Huang met with Trump in the Oval Office; separately NVDA highlighted $500B supply chain commitment and Arizona fab expansion. SpaceX reportedly planning 4GW compute capacity buildout using Rubin racks next year per FundaAI report, a bullish demand signal for NVDA. NVDA +2% pre-market amid broader semi recovery.

bullets.title: QCOM: JPM cuts PT to $215 from $265; Apple modem loss accelerates, margins under pressure
bullets.body: Qualcomm Q3 revenue $9.95B beat but EPS $2.21 missed; Q4 EPS guided $2.05-2.25 vs. $2.35 consensus. Apple modem share declining faster than prior 20% guidance—iPhone revenue expected to halve Dec quarter and become insignificant by FY27-end. Data center silicon ($600M in Dec Q, $5B FY27 target) provides offset but at lower margins (1.5-2% drag on QCT GM). JPM cut PT to $215, Citi cut to $175, UBS cut to $170; all maintain Neutral.

bullets.title: AMZN/AAPL: Reporting tonight; AWS expected +35-36%, AMZN 2026 capex likely raised to $210-215B
bullets.body: Amazon reports Thursday AH with consensus $1.82 EPS, $197B revenue; UBS expects AWS growth 35-36% YoY for Q2 and sees FY27 capex potentially $300-350B. Apple reports Thursday AH with consensus $1.89 EPS, $109B revenue; UBS models iPhone taking share with 20% revenue growth, September GM ~47.5% down 50bps, and foldable iPhone carrying 500-1000bps higher gross margin than iPhone 17 Pro.

bullets.title: PI: Beat + raise on retail recovery and ASIC progress; UBS maintains Neutral at $175
bullets.body: Impinj June Q revenue $108.4M beat $105.9M estimate; Sep Q guided $107M midpoint ($7M above UBS). Channel inventory declined 9-12%, bookings hit all-time high, and UPS ASIC transition ahead of schedule (full conversion expected Sep Q). Food retail pilots running at 3 of 5 major retailers; Walmart Phase 3 general merchandise program supportive for 2027. PT maintained at $175 (60x P/E on C2027E EPS of $2.90).

bullets.title: SOFI: MS cuts PT to $15; Mizuho cuts to $22 but argues bear case overblown
bullets.body: SoFi raised FY sales target but shares fell ~7% on EBITDA growth concerns and lower CET1 ratio. MS cut PT to $15 (prior not disclosed). Mizuho maintains Outperform, lowers PT to $22 from $29, arguing incremental margins remain 31% and capital ratios (18.8% total risk-based vs 10.5% minimum) are adequate. Management 2026 assumptions included two rate cuts—no hikes = free upside.

bullets.title: U (Unity): Piper raises PT to $45 on +15% Q2 Vector growth QoQ
bullets.body: Piper Sandler raises Unity PT to $45 from $40 after Vector spend doubled YoY and grew 2.5x from pre-Vector levels; Q2 Vector growth +15% QoQ. Flagged as actionable catalyst for positioning.

bullets.title: AAOI: Nearing 1x forward revenue; photonics supply chain positive on AXTI LTA deals
bullets.body: AppliedOptoelectronics cited as near 1x annualized forward revenue, described as 'hard to see dropping much lower.' Separately, positive read-throughs from AXTI's new long-term agreements with LITE and COHR signal continued photonics supply chain investment. Trader community broadly holds AAOI alongside LITE, COHR, VIAV.

bullets.title: LRCX: Beat and raise; WFE raised to low $150B; Citi/UBS maintain Buy with $435-$450 PTs
bullets.body: Lam Research Q4 revenue $6.72B beat $6.68B; Sep Q guided $8.10B vs. $7.5B Street. Record 52% gross margins; long-term GM target raised to 55%. WFE forecast raised to low $150B for 2026 from ~$140B. Citi maintains Buy at $450, UBS maintains Buy at $435. CY27 EPS estimated at $12.16 (UBS) and $9.74 (Wolfe) vs. Street $9.36 pre-call. 2027 described as 'extraordinary' for WFE.

bullets.title: DKNG: DraftKings launches SkyPicks in-flight free-to-play with Delta
bullets.body: DraftKings and Delta launched SkyPicks, a free-to-play in-flight sports contest available to Delta passengers. Brand awareness and engagement play; no near-term revenue impact disclosed.

bullets.title: RBLX: EU designates Roblox as 'very large online platform' under Digital Services Act
bullets.body: Roblox surpassed 45M monthly users in the EU, triggering designation as a 'very large online platform' subject to stricter content moderation rules, transparency reports, and fines up to 6% of global sales for breaches. Regulatory overhang now applicable.
